title: Size Guide Modal
content: Build size guide modal for apparel/footwear. Trigger: "Size Guide" link near size selector. Modal content: product category tabs if multiple (Tops, Bottoms, Shoes). Measurement table: columns for size (S/M/L or numeric), chest, waist, hips, length in both inches and cm. Unit toggle: switch between in/cm. "How to Measure" section with body diagram and instructions. Fit notes: "This item runs small, consider sizing up". Size recommendation based on previous purchases.

variants.simple: Create size guide modal with measurement table and tips.
variants.detailed: Build size guide modal for apparel/footwear. Trigger: "Size Guide" link near size selector. Modal content: product category tabs if multiple (Tops, Bottoms, Shoes). Measurement table: columns for size (S/M/L or numeric), chest, waist, hips, length in both inches and cm. Unit toggle: switch between in/cm. "How to Measure" section with body diagram and instructions. Fit notes: "This item runs small, consider sizing up". Size recommendation based on previous purchases.
variants.advanced: Build comprehensive size guide modal for apparel and footwear. Trigger: "Size Guide" text link (underline, text-gray-600) positioned near size selector, icon optional (Ruler). Modal: centered, max-w-2xl, bg-white rounded-xl shadow-2xl. Header: "Size Guide" title, close X button. Category tabs: if brand sells multiple categories, tabs for Tops, Bottoms, Dresses, Shoes, etc., each with own measurements. Unit toggle: prominent toggle switch for Inches/Centimeters in top-right, persisted to localStorage. Measurement table: clean table with borders, sticky header. Columns: Size (S, M, L, XL, XXL or numeric 6, 8, 10...), measurements relevant to category (Tops: Chest, Waist, Length; Bottoms: Waist, Hip, Inseam, Length; Shoes: US, UK, EU, CM). Highlight row on hover. Current size indicator: if user has size preference saved, highlight that row with subtle background. International conversion: for shoes, show US/UK/EU/JP conversions in same table. "How to Measure" section: illustrated diagrams (SVG or image) showing where to measure chest, waist, hips, inseam on body outline, numbered instructions: "1. Chest: Measure around the fullest part...", expandable/collapsible accordion format. Fit notes: product-specific callout box (bg-blue-50 border-l-4 border-blue-400): "This item runs small, we recommend sizing up" or "Relaxed fit - if between sizes, size down". Model measurements: "Model is 5'10" wearing size M" with model stats. Size recommendation: if user logged in with measurement profile, show "Based on your measurements, we recommend size M" with confidence indicator. Measurement input: optional section where user can enter their measurements and get personalized recommendation using algorithm. Previous purchase reference: "You bought size M in Similar Product and rated the fit as 'Perfect'" reminder. Brand comparison: "How our sizes compare to [Other Brand]" if available. Print friendly: "Print Size Guide" button with print-optimized styles. Mobile: full-screen modal (inset-0 rounded-none), horizontally scrollable table, collapsible sections. Video guide: optional embedded video showing how to measure. Accessibility: table with proper headers, unit toggle announces change, modal traps focus.

author: Ersin KOÇ
